title: When conversion follows grace
source_text: XXXII. Si quaeratur an positis omnibus operationibus quibus ad conversionem in hominibus efficiendam Deus utitur, conversio saepe vel nunquam non sequatur? Respondemus, posita gratia antecedente & praeveniente saepe non sequi, posita cooperante nunquam non.
pass_a_gloss: XXXII. If it is asked whether all the operations being posited which God uses for effecting conversion in men, conversion often or never fails to follow? We answer, antecedent & prevenient grace being posited it often does not follow, cooperating being posited never not.
pass_b_english: Thesis XXXII. 'If it is asked whether, when God has put in place every working he uses to bring about conversion in people, conversion often fails to follow or never fails, we answer: with antecedent and prevenient grace in place, it often does not follow; with cooperating grace in place, it never fails to follow.'

lemmas.gloss: conversion often or never fails to follow

choices.why: The Remonstrant term: grace acts so that the will can either yield to it or block it.
